items.headline: Lamar Jackson has a sprained ankle; only an outside chance to play at Atlanta
items.summary: Sources say the sprain leaves Jackson with only an outside chance for Sunday night. Tyler Huntley (5-6 as a fill-in starter) would start, which would cut Baltimore's passing projections and raise Derrick Henry's share of the offense.

items.headline: Ja'Marr Chase in concussion protocol before the Miami game
items.summary: Chase left Week 4 in the second quarter with a concussion. Cincinnati has a Week 6 bye, so it could rest him. Tee Higgins had 16 targets without him, but Higgins is also day-to-day.

items.headline: Tee Higgins (adductor) day-to-day after 11-catch, 157-yard game
items.summary: Zac Taylor called Higgins day-to-day after he got hurt on the final drive. If both Chase and Higgins sit, Dohnte Meyers becomes the top Bengals receiver.

items.headline: Barkley (hamstring) week-to-week; backup Tank Bigsby headed to IR
items.summary: Barkley's injury isn't seen as long term, but his status for the London game against Jacksonville is unclear. Bigsby needs core muscle surgery, so the Eagles backfield is thin behind Barkley.

items.headline: Eagles RT Lane Johnson retires; Barkley still week-to-week
items.summary: Losing the All-Pro right tackle for good makes it harder to fix a struggling Eagles offense in London against Jacksonville, especially with Saquon Barkley (hamstring) uncertain and Tank Bigsby on IR.

items.headline: Tank Bigsby to IR after core muscle surgery
items.summary: Bigsby led the Eagles in rushing after Barkley left Week 4. He is expected back in about six weeks.

items.headline: Commanders aim for Daniels (elbow) to practice fully and start vs. Giants
items.summary: Dan Quinn wants Daniels to get a full practice week and return Sunday. Marcus Mariota sprained his MCL in London, so rookie Athan Kaliakmanis is the fallback. Daniels still shows as out on the injury report until practice updates.

items.headline: Mariota sprained his right MCL; timeline to be determined
items.summary: This is the same knee injury Mariota had in the preseason. He won't start Week 5.

items.headline: Bagent named Bears starter at Green Bay; Caleb Williams won't practice
items.summary: Ben Johnson confirmed Bagent starts after going 25-of-34 for 268 yards in Week 4. Williams' hamstring is still week-to-week.

items.headline: Monangai (thumb) day-to-day after taking over the Bears backfield
items.summary: Monangai had 31 touches and 2 TDs in Week 4 after D'Andre Swift fumbled and was benched. The thumb injury could shift carries back to Swift against Green Bay.

items.headline: Chargers call McConkey (foot) week-to-week
items.summary: McConkey left Week 4 early after a setback. If he sits against Denver, Quentin Johnston and Tre' Harris lead the receivers.

items.headline: DJ Moore (shoulder) injury not considered long term
items.summary: Moore left Week 4 after a diving catch. Buffalo plays the Rams on Monday night, which gives him extra time to recover.

items.headline: Cardinals RB Jeremiyah Love dealing with a new ankle issue
items.summary: Mike LaFleur said this ankle problem isn't related to Love's August high-ankle sprain. Tyler Allgeier (8 carries, 1 TD in Week 4) would take more work against Detroit.

items.headline: Broncos WR Pat Bryant expected to miss a few weeks (ankle)
items.summary: Bryant sprained his right ankle against the 49ers. It's a small hit to a struggling Denver passing game before the Chargers game.

items.headline: Steelers unsure if Rico Dowdle (toe) returns vs. Colts
items.summary: Mike McCarthy said Dowdle had a good workout Friday and is making progress. Jaylen Warren keeps the lead role until Dowdle is cleared.

items.headline: Charbonnet stays on PUP for the 49ers game; Seattle passes on Joe Mixon
items.summary: With Jadarian Price on IR and Charbonnet still out, Emanuel Wilson (21 carries in Week 4) leads Seattle's backfield. The Seahawks decided not to sign Joe Mixon after his physical.

items.headline: Chiefs WR Tyquan Thornton out 12-16 weeks (ankle)
items.summary: Thornton dislocated his ankle in Week 4. Rashee Rice's hamstring is called minor. Kansas City is on bye in Week 5.

items.headline: Commanders WR Jaylin Lane out for the season (ankle)
items.summary: Washington's receivers are thin, and Terry McLaurin (hamstring) is still being evaluated before Wednesday's practice.

items.headline: McLaurin (hamstring) status for Giants game to be assessed Wednesday
items.summary: McLaurin missed the London game. If he sits again, Stefon Diggs keeps the top target role.
